'''Merkur''' was an enterprising [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who established [[Merkur's Cab Service]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].
==Biography==
Merkur, who was young by the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], was a [[clan]]less Bothan [[technician/Legends|mechanic]] from [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. One day he uncovered by chance an illegal [[speeder/Legends|speeder]] disassembly shop, and his silence was bought with a small fortune of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

With this money, he decided to disappear to [[Kothlis]] and start a new life. He bought an old vehicle bay in the [[Warehouse district (Tal'cara)|warehouse]] of [[Tal'cara]], and several old [[XP-32-1 Landspeeder]]s which he repaired, overhauled and refurbished; he did the same with five beat-up [[V1 pilot droid]]s, which he reprogrammed them to drive the speeders.<ref name="guide" />

He made high-ranking Bothans his customers, and he was kept always busy maintaining and servicing his speeders.<ref name="guide" /> 
==Personality and traits==
Merkur was asocial but his lack of charisma was countered by his enterpreneurship and talent with a [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanner]]—which he preferred over company with other beings.<ref name="guide" />
